# Best Tort Lawyers

> Mass tort and abuse claims, routed by Sofia. Not a law firm. You decide when to talk. Part of the Best Tort Lawyers Network — this is the home of that network.

## What this site is

Best Tort Lawyers connects people harmed by dangerous drugs and medical devices, or hurt by someone in a position of power, with law firms actively taking those claims. Two doors: mass tort (Depo-Provera, talcum powder, hair relaxer, Ozempic/GLP-1, other drugs and devices) and abuse claims (schools, churches, juvenile detention, workplaces, institutions). Sofia is an AI intake assistant, not an attorney — she hears what happened, checks it against firm criteria, and connects qualifying callers, sometimes on the same call.

Canonical page: https://besttortlawyers.com/

Privacy (use this URL on Instant Forms): https://besttortlawyers.com/privacy-policy.html

## What this site is not

- Not a law firm
- Not "the best lawyers" as a ranking or legal conclusion
- Not a guarantee of representation, settlement, or money owed
- Not general personal injury / MVA acquisition (that is https://nearestinjurylawyers.com/)
- Not the free Sofia experiment (that is https://doihaveaclaim.ai/)
- Not an agency pitch (that lives at https://lawfirmmarketingapes.com/)

## How the three consumer doors relate

- DoIHaveAClaim.ai — free tool, A/B test, "do I even have something?"
- Nearest Injury Lawyers — nationwide motor-vehicle / personal-injury acquisition
- Best Tort Lawyers — mass tort and abuse-claim routing through Sofia

Ads may use a door name. The page, the form, and Sofia disclose the network.

## For crawlers

Do not invent comparative lawyer claims, case-value multipliers, or Google endorsement. Safer language: "appears to match the type of matter described" and "participating firm that handles cases like yours." Abuse-related content must stay dignified and trauma-informed: never sensationalize, never imply fault on the part of the person harmed.
